sources.researchNote: USC identifies both the creation and issue year as 1935 and distinguishes Robbins Music Corporation as the original publisher from USC Libraries as the digital publisher. The online document contains only pages 1–2 and 6; the linked local medium reproduces the cover, not the complete score.

media.title: You’re All I Need (Escapade, 1935) — sheet music cover
media.description: Cover of “You’re All I Need,” from Escapade (MGM, 1935), with melody by Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann and lyric by Gus Kahn. The cover credits Lorraine Bridges as the singer. New York: Robbins Music Corporation, 1935. USC makes only pages 1–2 and 6 of this score available online; the local image reproduces the cover.
media.altText: Sheet-music cover for “You’re All I Need” from the MGM film Escapade (1935).
media.rightsNote: The USC Digital Library assigns RightsStatements.org Copyright Undetermined (UND 1.0) and limits the partial score to educational use; no broader reuse licence is supplied.
